basic_info.description: Charming Outer Sunset home ideally located just short blocks from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, MUNI lines, and the vibrant shops and eateries along Noriega, Judah, and Irving Street - Andytown Coffee Roaster is just around the corner. The main level features a bright and spacious living room, a beautiful newly updated open kitchen flowing into the dining area, and a serene primary suite with ocean views, an en-suite bath, and direct access to the rear deck and garden. Two additional bedrooms (or office/flex space) and a full bath complete the top floor. The lower level, accessible through a separate entrance via the garage, offers a legal family room, full bath, and storage room - plus bonus rooms for added versatility. The expansive flat backyard includes mature citrus trees and plants. Recent upgrades include fresh interior and exterior paint, newly refinished hardwood floors, and new hardwood and luxury vinyl flooring throughout.
